[27019] Mysx/remx: Wisdom of the Dolphins: Living in Key West I was amazed by how the local dolphins seemed attracted to those in sorrow. I had dropped by to see a mystic friend whose granddaughter [grade5] just arrived - she had been removed from her parents custody by court order. When we made our next stop she was 1st into the water. Within 5 minutes they were swimming together…  they were both at the same age - young adolescents.
